kjv: The transgression of the wicked saith within my heart (KJV 36:1)
mine: Transgression speaks to the wicked deep in his heart
note: MT libbi "my heart"; I follow some Hebrew mss, LXX, Syriac and Jerome in reading libbo "his heart", since the rest of the verse describes the wicked man's inner life; the KJV keeps "my heart".
